head: 4788ed41747b923165745af748a078bfb534ba20
note: AUDIT-AUTHORED harnesses; never file as upstream code. Medusa targets the same harness contracts the forge wrappers drive.

invariants.name: S1_executesRealHop
invariants.description: Every route setRoute accepts makes Router NG v1.1 execute >=1 hop on a non-zero pool (hop 1 always runs).

invariants.name: S2_deliversTokenOut
invariants.description: For every accepted route, the independent RouterNGv11Model's delivered token route[2*hops] == tokenOut and path[0] == tokenIn.

invariants.name: S3_noUnexecutedNonZeroSlot
invariants.description: Accepted routes have no non-zero path slot after 2*hops, no non-zero swap_params row >= hops, and no non-zero pools slot >= hops.

invariants.name: S4_noZeroExecutedToken
invariants.description: No executed hop outputs token address(0).

invariants.name: storedEqualsInput
invariants.description: An accepted setRoute stores exactly its calldata (path, swapParams, pools) and configured=true.

invariants.name: completeness
invariants.description: A structurally contiguous route (k in 1..5, non-zero tokens/pools, swap_type 1..8, zero padding, path[0]=tokenIn, path[2k]=tokenOut) is never rejected.

invariants.name: P2_rejectDoesNotMutate
invariants.description: A rejected setRoute leaves routes[tokenIn][tokenOut] byte-identical. NOTE: guaranteed by EVM revert atomicity, so it passes on every variant (including mutants); retained for completeness, not as discriminating evidence.

invariants.name: P2_storedRoutesValid
invariants.description: After any call sequence, every configured route over the 4x4 token alphabet satisfies S1-S4. This is the discriminating form of P2.

invariants.name: RESIDUAL_swapTypeInRange
invariants.description: Executed swap_type in Router NG v1.1's {1..8}. EXPECTED FAIL on HEAD (profiler LOCAL-002, denylist {0,9}).

invariants.name: RESIDUAL_noSelfPair
invariants.description: tokenIn != tokenOut. EXPECTED FAIL on HEAD (profiler LOCAL-001 / L-07 b28e77daefb3 residual).

invariants.name: I1_totalDepositedEqualsSum
invariants.description: getTotalDeposited(USDe) == sum principalOf over the 3 clients (the only accounts ever credited).

invariants.name: I2_pLeD
invariants.description: principalOf(client) <= totalDeposited for every client.

invariants.name: I3_withdrawDebitIsCappedRequest
invariants.description: withdraw/withdrawAsOwner debits exactly min(request, p) (so a <= p).

invariants.name: I4_dominanceCapBindsImpliesUnderwater
invariants.description: If convertToShares(min(req,p)) > vault.balanceOf(strategy) before an exit, then totalBalanceOf(client) < principalOf(client) (StableStakerV2 _isUnderwater dominates cap-binding).

invariants.name: I5_skimNeverSellsPrincipalBacking
invariants.description: If position value >= totalDeposited before skimSurplus, it remains >= totalDeposited after.

invariants.name: I6_adapterHoldsNothing
invariants.description: CurveAMMAdapter holds 0 USDe, crvUSD and sUSDe after every action (pure pass-through).

invariants.name: I7_strategyHoldsNoIdleUnderlying
invariants.description: The strategy holds 0 idle USDe after every action (the returned amount equals the delivered amount).

invariants.name: I8_totalWithdrawalZeroesExactlyP
invariants.description: A successful Phase-2 totalWithdrawal zeroes the client's principal and reduces D by exactly p. Deliberately stronger than the code: it does not exempt the documented no-op returns.

invariants.name: I8b_totalWithdrawalZeroesPOutsideDocumentedNoOps
invariants.description: I8 restricted to cases where totalShares > 0 and totalShares*p/D > 0.

invariants.name: I9_sharesDisposedLeConvertToSharesA
invariants.description: Shares leaving the strategy on withdraw <= vault.convertToShares(min(req,p)).

invariants.name: REACH_* witnesses
invariants.description: Medusa reachability properties EXPECTED to fail: route accept+reject+multi-hop+mutated-accept; market all exit paths succeeded, cap binds, slippage reverts.
